description: These official statistics count planning applications received and decided by local planning authorities in England, by type of development, outcome and speed of decision. They are published by the Ministry of Housing, Communities and Local Government in a quarterly series, with releases from 2010 on GOV.UK; the latest read covered April to June 2026 and was published on 24 September 2026. The live tables include district tables P120 to P138, speed and quality of major and non-major decisions (P151 to P155), prior approvals for permitted development (PDR 1 to 3), and full open-data CSVs of the district (PS1, PS2) and county (CPS1, CPS2) returns, with data dictionaries and a dashboard. Coverage: all local planning authorities in England. Access: GOV.UK live tables and CSV downloads; the older district tables once listed on data.gov.uk pointed to the Open Data Communities SPARQL service, which refused access when checked. Licence: Open Government Licence v3.0; free. Caveats: counts are applications, not dwellings or floorspace, and definitions of major development follow the returns. Simulation uses: trends in approved development for building stock growth and pipeline scenarios. Related records: the England listed buildings and conservation areas records from the Planning Data platform.
